issue.title: Using formatResults on a beforeFind crashes

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
This is a (multiple allowed):

* [x] bug
* [ ] enhancement
* [ ] feature-discussion (RFC)

* CakePHP Version: > 3.3.x. Checked under 3.3.8 and 3.3.9
* Platform and Target: All. Checked under linux, but should fail in all systems.

### What you did
Use `formatResults` on a model's or behavior's `beforeFind`.

I've created an empty project where you can see the error: https://github.com/elboletaire/matching-issue.

@lorenzo said he was able to reproduce this error under cakephp's test suite. I'm a bit lost on this, but if you tell me those test lines I could try to do a PR during this week.

### What happened
The app crashes with the error 

    Argument 1 passed to mapEntity() must be an instance of Cake\ORM\Entity, array given, called in {class} on line 65

\* Error reduced. In my project example crashes due to a `beforeFind` calling a finder with `formatResults` on a behavior.

### What you expected to happen
Execute `formatResults` without errors on a `beforeFind`, the way it works with a normal Query.
